data.rationale: The proposal gets the core procedure right (Careers, Openings, then country, team and time type filters, then search) with the right parameters in order, but it omits the final step of opening or applying to the target job and the matching `action` parameter, and it doesn't say how the filter values are chosen, so an automation would stop short of the true goal.
